articles.title: The 7+ best water flossers that help remove plaque from your teeth
articles.summary: Are water flossers as effective as dental floss? Dentists explain, and share how to properly use them.
articles.body: Standing in front of the mirror and maneuvering thin floss between your teeth isn’t pleasant. But even when it feels like a chore, flossing is an essential part of any oral hygiene routine — it removes plaque, a sticky bacterial film that coats your teeth and can lead to cavities, as well as eventual tooth decay. However, old school dental floss is not your only option. Water flossers may be more comfortable and easier to use, but are they effective? I talked to dentists to learn more about the pros and cons of water flossers, how to shop for them and what models are worth buying. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The best water flossers of 2026 All the water flossers below meet experts’ shopping guidance and have at least a 4.0-star average rating from hundreds of reviews at major retailers like Amazon, Target and Best Buy. For each model, I included the following important information: power source, water reservoir size, pressure settings, included tips and whether its tip rotates 360 degrees. Every water flosser on the list below has an on/off switch built into its handle so you can easily pause the stream. Best corded The Waterpik Aquarius is one of the most popular models on the market and it also earned the ADA’s Seal of Acceptance. You can remove the water flosser’s 22-ounce reservoir from its base, making filling and cleaning in the dishwasher convenient. The device uses pressure and pulsations to lift plaque off teeth, and you can choose a pressure setting using the built-in dial. You’re also able to select between two modes: floss and massage. One flossing session lasts 90 seconds — the water flosser briefly pauses at 30 seconds and one minute to help you keep track of time. It comes with four types of tips: standard precision, orthodontic, pik pocket (best for periodontal pockets) and plaque seeker (best for dental work like implants, bridges and retainers). Best cordless Philip Sonicare’s cordless water flosser has two tips: standard and quad stream. The quad stream option is X-shaped, so the water stream is wide when it comes out of the nozzle and covers more tooth surface area, according to the brand. The wand has an 8-ounce reservoir built into its handle, which holds enough water for one minute of flossing. The ADA-accepted water flosser runs for up to 14 days on a fully charged battery and comes with a USB charging cable. You can choose from two flossing modes: clean mode, which maintains constant pressure and briefly pauses water flow every 15 seconds, and deep clean with pulse, which increases and decreases water flow during use. Editor’s pick Former NBC Selected editorial projects manager Rebecca Rodriguez has been using Waterpik’s water flossers for years and most recently opted for this cordless ADA-accepted model due to the limited counter space in her apartment’s bathroom. “It’s so satisfying to see just how much the water flosser cleans out the nooks and crannies of my mouth,” she says. “It also has an impressive battery life — I charge it about once every three or four weeks. Plus, the three pressure settings let me alternate between low pressure for areas of my mouth that might be sensitive and high pressure for when there’s something really stuck in there.” This water flosser comes with a magnetic charging system, which re-powers the device in about four hours, according to the brand. The handle also has a battery life indicator so you know when to plug it in. Its removable, dishwasher-safe reservoir snaps into the back of the handle and holds enough water for about 45 seconds of flossing. The water flosser has four tips: standard precision, orthodontic and plaque seeker (best for dental work like implants, bridges and retainers). You also get a microfiber travel bag, a travel water plug and a tip storage case. Best budget buy AquaSonic’s water flosser is a lower-priced model designed with all the features experts recommend looking for. It has a removable reservoir that connects to the handle, and it comes with four types of tips: standard, periodontal, orthodontic and a tongue scraper. You also get a storage bag to house everything while traveling. The water flosser charges overnight and its battery lasts for weeks, according to the brand. Easiest to clean The other cordless water flossers on this list have two or three pressure settings, but this one has five, giving you the most control over the stream’s strength. As the device pushes water through its nozzle, it creates microbubbles that help break up food and debris on the surface of your teeth, according to the brand. Its reservoir, built into the back of the handle, holds enough water for about 60 seconds of flossing. Notably, the model is water-resistant and its reservoir is removable and dishwasher-safe. Best toothbrush water flosser This ADA-accepted device looks like a standard electric toothbrush, but it’s also a water flosser — a small opening in the middle of its brush head shoots out pressurized water. You can use the device to brush, floss or do both simultaneously by selecting a mode on its handle. When you exclusively use it as a toothbrush, the handle is cordless. But when you use it as a water flosser, you plug a cord into the bottom of the handle, connecting it to the dishwasher-safe, removable reservoir, which holds enough water for 60 seconds of flossing. The device’s base must be plugged into an outlet because it charges the handle. Waterpik’s flossing toothbrush has two brush speeds, a two-minute brushing timer and a dial on its base that lets you choose from 10 floss pressures. It comes with full-size and travel-size flossing brush heads, brush head covers, a toothbrush travel case and a brush head storage post that magnetically connects to the base. Best for beginners With only two buttons on its handle, two pressure settings and one type of tip, Quip’s ADA-accepted water flosser has a simple, straightforward design ideal for beginners. Once you plug the device into its charger, it repowers in four hours — a full battery lasts up to eight weeks, according to the brand. The reservoir, which holds enough water for 60 seconds of flossing, is built into the handle, and it has a wide lid that opens at the top, making it easy to fill. To help you remember when to replace the water flosser’s tip, Quip offers a subscription service that sends you a new one every three months for $7. Best for travel This compact water flosser is about the size of an iPhone, so you can take it with you when you travel. It’s also great for people who have braces or other dental devices that need more frequent cleaning since you can easily take it to work or school. One charge can last up to 30 days, according to the brand. While this exact model isn’t ADA-approved, it matches the power and effectiveness of the brand’s full size device, which is certified by the ADA. What are water flossers? Water flossers are powered handheld devices that look like little wands or electric toothbrushes. They shoot pressurized water at the spaces between your teeth to flush out plaque and help keep gum tissue healthy, says Dr. Amr Moursi, an NYU College of Dentistry professor. They function differently than dental floss, which mechanically scrapes plaque away from the surface of teeth, says Dr. Samantha Rawdin, a prosthodontist at Gallery 57 Dental in New York City. How I picked the best water flossers Experts recommend considering the following factors while shopping for water flossers (which you may also see called powered interdental cleaners and oral irrigators). Remember that the more bells and whistles a water flosser has, the more it typically costs. ADA Seal of Acceptance: A water flosser earns the American Dental Association’s Seal of Acceptance if a brand submits data to the organization showing that its device is safe for teeth and effective at reducing plaque and gingivitis. This doesn’t mean water flossers without the ADA Seal are ineffective — it just means brands haven’t submitted their products for the organization to review, says Dr. Edmond Hewlett, a professor at the UCLA School of Dentistry. Only five brands of water flossers currently have the ADA Seal of Acceptance: Waterpik, Philips Sonicare, Quip, AquaSonic and Coslus. You can learn more here.Cordless v.s. corded: Water flossers are either corded and must be plugged in while you use them, or they’re cordless and built with rechargeable batteries. To decide between the two, think about whether you want to dedicate an outlet in your bathroom to the water flosser and whether you plan to keep it out all the time. If you have limited counter space in your bathroom and/or plan to travel with your water flosser, a cordless model is the best option. But if you have lots of counter space in your bathroom and only plan to use it at home, a corded model is a great choice.Water reservoir size: Water flossers have reservoirs that hold the liquid they eventually shoot out of their nozzles. Some reservoirs are large, so they hold enough water for a few cleanings, while others are small and only hold enough water for one cleaning. Corded water flossers typically have larger water reservoirs compared to cordless models.Pressure settings: Different pressure settings let you adjust the strength of the stream that comes out of your water flosser. Flexibility is important, especially if you’re new to water flossers and learning how to use one, says Rawdin.Tips: Many water flossers come with interchangeable tips that you attach to the wand’s head. Some tips target specific needs, like orthodontics, periodontal pockets and implants, while others are for general plaque removal. Think about your dental needs to decide which you feel are the most important to look for, and be sure to buy a water flosser that comes with two or more tips, especially if you’re sharing it with someone. You’ll need to clean and replace the tips over time and buy new ones as needed (more on tip care below). Also, look for tips that rotate 360 degrees to clean your mouth at different angles. articles.title: Erdogan chama guerra em Gaza de 'ecocídio' na COP31 da ONU | G1
articles.standfirst: Relatório da ONU aponta que a guerra destruiu áreas agrícolas, contaminou o solo e a água e comprometeu os meios de subsistência de milhões de palestinos.
articles.summary: Na COP31, Erdogan classificou a guerra em Gaza como um ecocídio, citando a destruição de 97% das áreas de cultivo e a contaminação vital do solo e da água no território.
articles.body:
Presidente da Turquia, Recep Tayyip Erdogan. Foto de 1º de setembro de 2026. — Foto: Sputnik/Vyacheslav Prokofyev/Pool via REUTERS

O presidente da Turquia, Recep Tayyip Erdogan , pediu nesta quarta-feira (11) que o mundo reconheça os impactos ambientais da guerra entre Israel e o Hamas na Faixa de Gaza . Ele também cobrou do governo israelense que permita a entrada de mais ajuda humanitária no território palestino.

Erdogan discursou durante a Conferência das Nações Unidas sobre Mudanças Climáticas (COP31), realizada em Antalya, na Turquia.

"O que aconteceu em Gaza não é apenas um genocídio, mas também um ecocídio", afirmou Erdogan, sob aplausos de líderes mundiais e representantes de governos presentes na cúpula.

Um painel de especialistas independentes apoiado pela ONU concluiu, no ano passado, que Israel cometeu genocídio em Gaza. Israel nega veementemente as acusações e acusou o painel de antissemitismo.

"Oliveiras centenárias foram derrubadas. O solo e a água foram contaminados em Gaza, e as cidades do território foram transformadas em enormes montanhas de escombros", disse Erdogan. "Com a infraestrutura de Gaza destruída, as chuvas torrenciais e as enchentes fizeram com que dezenas de milhares de barracas e abrigos ficassem inundados."

O Ministério das Relações Exteriores de Israel não respondeu imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário. O país não foi convidado para a COP31.

Erdogan é um crítico declarado de Israel, enquanto o primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, já chamou o presidente turco de "tirano" antissemita.

"O mais novo país a se tornar um grande propagador de mentiras antissemitas é a Turquia", afirmou Netanyahu em setembro, durante discurso na Assembleia Geral da ONU.

Nos últimos dias, fortes chuvas e as consequentes enchentes destruíram muitas das barracas e dos abrigos improvisados onde vivem atualmente os palestinos deslocados pela guerra. Pelo menos quatro pessoas morreram no início desta semana, quando um barranco de areia desabou sobre o abrigo em que estavam.

A chuva também deixou muitos deslocados sem comida, água potável ou um lugar seco para dormir.

A ajuda humanitária continua entrando no território, mas as importações permanecem muito abaixo dos níveis registrados antes do início da guerra entre Israel e o Hamas. Além disso, muitos produtos continuam bloqueados por Israel.

Israel iniciou sua ofensiva na Faixa de Gaza após os ataques de militantes liderados pelo Hamas contra o sul do território israelense, em 7 de outubro de 2023. Os ataques mataram cerca de 1.200 pessoas e fizeram 251 reféns.

A ofensiva israelense em resposta aos ataques matou mais de 74 mil pessoas, segundo autoridades de saúde locais, e destruiu grande parte de Gaza. O Ministério da Saúde, que integra o governo do território controlado pelo Hamas, não diferencia civis de combatentes, mas afirma que mulheres e crianças representam quase metade dos mortos.

Palestinos deslocados caminham por um acampamento inundado após fortes chuvas. — Foto: Abdel Kareem Hana/AP

Um relatório de 2025 do Programa das Nações Unidas para o Meio Ambiente (Pnuma) detalhou a situação ambiental devastadora de Gaza desde o início da guerra.

Segundo o documento, avaliações feitas por sensoriamento remoto indicaram que, até maio de 2025, mais de 97% das áreas de cultivo de árvores, 82% das lavouras anuais, 95% das áreas de vegetação arbustiva e 89% dos campos de pastagem e terras em pousio haviam sido danificados.

"Atualmente, nossas famílias têm apenas 3% das terras agrícolas disponíveis para uso, considerando que essa área precisaria ser distribuída entre 2 milhões de palestinos" na Faixa de Gaza, afirmou Mohammed Usrof, cofundador e diretor-executivo do Instituto Palestino de Estratégia Climática.

"Não falar sobre essas perdas compromete o abastecimento de alimentos dos palestinos, seus meios de subsistência e sua capacidade de permanecer em suas terras", disse Usrof.

A capacidade do território de coletar lixo, tratar esgoto e fornecer água limpa foi praticamente destruída por três anos de guerra. Segundo organizações humanitárias, a situação agravou as condições já precárias de vida e aumentou os riscos à saúde de centenas de milhares de pessoas sem acesso adequado a abrigo, alimentos e medicamentos.

O conflito praticamente eliminou os meios de subsistência ligados à pesca em Gaza, segundo o relatório. O documento também destaca que os ecossistemas marinhos foram contaminados por munições, esgoto e resíduos sólidos.

"Para as pessoas em Gaza, isso significa acesso extremamente limitado à água potável, maior exposição a doenças transmitidas pela água e a substâncias tóxicas, agravamento da insegurança alimentar e perda de meios de subsistência ligados à agricultura e à pesca", afirmou Ghiwa Nakat, diretora-executiva do Greenpeace MENA, à Associated Press.

Nakat também alertou que o meio ambiente de Gaza pode levar anos para se recuperar.

"Os danos ambientais não vão acabar quando a guerra terminar", disse. "O solo e as águas subterrâneas contaminados, os ecossistemas destruídos e o colapso de infraestruturas ambientais essenciais podem comprometer a saúde pública, a segurança alimentar e os meios de subsistência por gerações, ameaçando a capacidade de resistência e recuperação das comunidades."

Líderes mundiais iniciaram nesta semana as negociações oficiais da COP31, em busca de um acordo sobre medidas concretas para conter o aquecimento global, após um ano marcado por enchentes mortais, ondas de calor e outros desastres relacionados às mudanças climáticas.

Mais de 70 líderes mundiais e autoridades de alto escalão participam da cúpula. Alguns representantes de países importantes, no entanto, estão ausentes, incluindo os chefes de Estado dos Estados Unidos, da China e da Índia.

articles.title: Transatlântico é afundado na costa da Flórida para criar recife  | G1
articles.standfirst: O projeto, orçado em cerca de US$ 13,5 milhões, busca atrair mergulhadores e entusiastas da pesca para a região.
articles.summary: O projeto, orçado em cerca de US$ 13,5 milhões, busca atrair mergulhadores e entusiastas da pesca para a região.
articles.body:
Foto de arquivo: o transatlântico aposentado SS United States em um cais na Filadélfia, Pensilvânia, em 10 de outubro de 2015. — Foto: Jewel Samad/AFP

Um transatlântico americano, maior que o Titanic e que realizou mais de 800 viagens nas décadas de 1950 e 1960, foi afundado nesta quarta-feira (11) na costa da Flórida para se transformar no "maior recife artificial do mundo" e em um destino turístico.

O casco do SS United States, com mais de 300 metros de comprimento - cerca de 30 metros a mais que o Titanic -, deverá ser gradualmente inundado até afundar nas águas do Golfo do México, a aproximadamente 40 km de Destin, na costa noroeste da Flórida.

Equipes se preparam para afundar o antigo transatlântico SS United States para criar um recife artificial a cerca de 35 km da costa de Destin, Flórida, EUA, em 11 de novembro de 2026. — Foto: Tony Giberson/USA Today Network via Reuters

Para que o navio afundasse sem o uso de explosivos, foram abertas as válvulas que alimentavam seu sistema de refrigeração, mais de 400 vigias do casco foram removidas e grandes aberturas foram feitas em seus conveses.

O projeto, orçado em cerca de US$ 13,5 milhões, busca atrair mergulhadores e entusiastas da pesca para a região do recife artificial, anunciado como o maior do mundo, que criará um habitat para a fauna marinha.

O imponente transatlântico transportou a bordo inúmeras celebridades, entre elas John F. Kennedy, Marilyn Monroe, Salvador Dalí e até mesmo Walt Disney. Bill Clinton também viajou no navio durante sua juventude, quando se dirigia à Universidade de Oxford para estudar.

A primeira travessia do Atlântico pelo SS United States ocorreu em 1952, e a última, em 1969.

Agora, a gigantesca embarcação deverá repousar no fundo do mar, a 55 metros de profundidade, com seu ponto mais alto a 18 metros da superfície.

Até agora, o maior recife artificial era um antigo porta-aviões afundado há vinte anos na costa de Pensacola, também na Flórida.

Antes de ser transformado em recife submarino, o SS United States passou mais de um quarto de século atracado em um cais da Filadélfia, na costa leste dos Estados Unidos.

articles.title: Will Sheikh Hasina return to Bangladesh?
articles.summary: The former Bangladeshi PM says she is planning to go back, despite a death sentence.
articles.body:
She faces being hanged. Yet, Sheikh Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh and would rather die in her country.

She served twice as prime minister, but was forced to resign and flee after large-scale street protests more than two years ago.

Since then, she has been living in India, which has refused a request by Bangladesh to hand her over.

Hasina says she asked for a new passport to return. But the government in Dhaka turned down the request.

The former leader announced she will return home in December, no matter what.

So, what would her possible return mean for politics in Bangladesh?

Taqbir Huda – Human rights lawyer and a Clarendon scholar at the University of Oxford

articles.title: Baic Arcfox T5 chega ao Brasil por R$ 219.990; SUV elétrico recarrega em 18 minutos | G1
articles.standfirst: O utilitário chega ao Brasil apostando no tamanho para justificar o preço mais alto em comparação com modelos de marcas como BYD, GWM, GAC, Leapmotor, Geely e até Chevrolet.
articles.summary: O utilitário chega ao Brasil apostando no tamanho para justificar o preço mais alto em comparação com modelos de marcas como BYD, GWM, GAC, Leapmotor, Geely e até Chevrolet.
articles.body:
A BAIC anunciou nesta quarta-feira (11) a chegada do Arcfox T5 por R$ 219.990 em versão única. Preço é maior que maior parte dos concorrentes.

O utilitário 100% elétrico tem 4,76 metros de comprimento, o mesmo tamanho do Jeep Commander. O Arcfox T5 também mede 1,95 metro de largura e 1,65 metro de altura.

O preço, porém, chegou salgado para o segmento em que o Arcfox T5 compete . Entre seus concorrentes estão:

Os três SUVs elétricos mais vendidos do Brasil, segundo dados da Associação Brasileira do Veículo Elétrico (ABVE).

Segundo a BAIC, o utilitário tem uma bateria de 64,8 kWh e aceita recarga rápida de até 210 kW. Com essa potência, é possível carregar a bateria de 30% a 80% em 18 minutos. A autonomia divulgada pela fabricante é de 362 km.

O motor elétrico fica na dianteira e entrega 252 cv de potência e 32,63 kgfm de torque. O carro acelera de 0 a 100 km/h em 8,8 segundos.

Por dentro, o Arcfox T5 tem um visual típico dos carros chineses, com poucos botões físicos e uma tela de 15,6 polegadas que concentra boa parte dos comandos do veículo. Ela é a única do painel, já que informações como velocidade e autonomia são projetadas diretamente no para-brisa.

O sistema de som tem 18 alto-falantes, e os bancos dianteiros oferecem função de massagem.

Fundada em 1958, em Pequim, a BAIC tem cerca de 130 mil funcionários e presença comercial em mais de 130 países e regiões. Em 2025, o grupo vendeu 1,75 milhão de veículos no mundo, dos quais 308 mil foram enviados ao exterior.

No Brasil, o grupo chinês BAIC confirmou que pretende lançar 10 carros até 2028, incluindo uma picape, e também anunciou a construção de uma fábrica no país. A operação será dividida em três submarcas: BAIC, voltada a SUVs híbridos; Arcfox, focada em crossovers; e Stelato, destinada aos modelos de luxo.

A marca já trabalha para adaptar alguns de seus modelos híbridos para rodar também com etanol. O primeiro será o BAIC X55. Segundo a empresa, a tecnologia será posteriormente aplicada a outros modelos.

A estratégia de expansão da BAIC prevê a abertura de 150 pontos de venda no Brasil até o fim de 2027. Atualmente, 50 lojas já estão prontas e devem começar a funcionar em dezembro.

A empresa pretende cobrir 112 zonas de influência. A estratégia é instalar lojas em cidades que também possam atender municípios próximos, ampliando a área de atuação da rede.

A Stelato terá uma estratégia diferente das demais submarcas. A marca de luxo terá uma operação própria e será lançada somente depois que a rede da BAIC estiver estabelecida no país.

Segundo Oswaldo Ramos, diretor de operações da BAIC, a fábrica anunciada pelo grupo terá um modelo de produção com importação das peças separadamente para montagem no Brasil. O sistema é o mesmo utilizado pela GWM, onde o executivo também trabalhou.

Com isso, a operação não seguirá os modelos SKD e CKD utilizados por outras fabricantes , como a BYD, MG e Chevrolet. Ramos afirma que o objetivo é colocar a BAIC entre as 10 marcas mais vendidas no Brasil até 2028 e entre as cinco primeiras em 2030.

articles.title: Prédio desaba na região do Brooklyn, em Nova York, e deixa 1 morto | G1
articles.standfirst: Outras duas ficaram gravemente feridas e uma terceira está presa sob os escombros. Uma obra ao lado do edifício teria provocado o desabamento segundo as autoridades.
articles.summary: Outras duas ficaram gravemente feridas e uma terceira está presa sob os escombros. Uma obra ao lado do edifício teria provocado o desabamento segundo as autoridades.
articles.body:
Um prédio de três andares desabou nesta quarta-feira (11) na região do Brooklyn, na cidade de Nova York , nos Estados Unidos . Equipes de emergência foram acionadas às pressas e trabalham para retirar vítimas dos escombros.

Ao menos uma pessoa morreu e outras 10 ficaram feridas , segundo um representante do Corpo de Bombeiros ouvido pela rede de TV CNN Internacional. Quatro dos feridos estavam em estado grave e uma pessoa estava presa nos escombros.

Uma obra ao lado do edifício teria provocado o desabamento, segundo as autoridades.

O prédio desabou no bairro de Flatbush, na região central do Brooklyn, uma área predominantemente residencial. A ocorrência foi registrada por volta das 18h (no horário de Brasília), segundo os bombeiros.

Edifício desaba no Brooklyn, em Nova York — Foto: Angelina Katsanis/Reuters

O prédio tinha um estabelecimento comercial no térreo e apartamentos nos andares superiores. A estrutura cedeu parcialmente, deixando parte de pelo menos um apartamento exposta. Uma escada, uma cama e armários ficaram visíveis do lado de fora do prédio.

O defensor público de Nova York, Jumaane Williams, esteve no local e disse que ainda havia pessoas tentando sair dos destroços.

"Acabamos de ver uma criança pequena passar. Felizmente, ouvi dizer que ela está respirando", afirmou ao jornal americano "The New York Times".

O prédio que desabou foi construído em 1930 e abrigava quatro apartamentos, de acordo com registros da prefeitura de Nova York.

O terreno vizinho, onde havia uma obra, era ocupado por uma construção de apenas um andar.

Em março, o Departamento de Edificações da cidade determinou a interrupção de uma demolição no imóvel. Durante uma nova inspeção, porém, fiscais constataram que toda a estrutura havia sido derrubada, segundo o New York Times.

A prefeitura aplicou uma multa de US$ 10 mil ao proprietário por descumprir a determinação.

As causas do desabamento ainda não haviam sido divulgadas até a última atualização das informações.

Bombeiros retiram pessoa ferida de edifício que desabou no Brooklyn, em Nova York — Foto: ABC Affiliate WABC via Reuters

articles.title: Menino morto na garupa da bicleta do pai é enterrado em Cabo Frio | G1
articles.standfirst: Pais cobram justiça pela morte de Isaque. Defesa do motorista afirma que ele está abalado e pede desculpas à família.
articles.summary: Pais cobram justiça pela morte de Isaque. Defesa do motorista afirma que ele está abalado e pede desculpas à família.
articles.body:
O corpo de Isaque de Jesus Chermouth , de 8 anos, atropelado segundos após subir na garupa da bicicleta do pai , foi velado e enterrado nesta quarta-feira (11), no Cemitério Santa Izabel, em Cabo Frio , na Região dos Lagos do Rio. O menino saia da escola, quando o carro avançou sobre eles nesta terça-feira (10).

Ao g1 , a mãe da criança, Jussara Silva Chermouth , disse que o filho não teve chance de sobreviver, questionando que após o impacto, o motorista, Iano Assis, de 75 anos, seguiu com o veículo por vários metros.

"O meu filho não teve uma chance. Eu fico me perguntando por que ele não parou? Por que ele não puxou o freio de mão? Ele passou por cima e foi arrastando, e passou na cabeça do meu filho", afirmou.

Jussara lembrou da alegria do filho, que estava na expectativa para dançar valsa de 15 anos com a irmã , que faz aniversário daqui a dois meses.

"Era um garoto muito alegre, carinhoso. Adorava Lego. Ele está usando o terninho que ele queria dançar valsa de 15 anos com a irmã. Ele falou: 'Mãe, quero muito dançar'. Ele não vai dançar mais", disse.

O advogado do motorista envolvido no atropelamento afirmou que Iano Assis está "profundamente transtornado, emocionalmente abalado e inconformado com a tragédia" e pediu desculpas à família de Isaque. (confira a nota na integra no final desta matéria)

O pai, Wanderson Chermouth , também cobrou justiça pela morte do filho e falou sobre o sofrimento da família após a tragédia.

"Então, a gente soube que o assassino do meu filho dormiu em casa. Ele pagou uma fiança de R$ 10 mil. O meu filho está aqui morto, não vale esses 10 mil", declarou.

Segundo Wanderson, Isaque era uma criança carinhosa e muito próxima da família.

"O meu filho merece justiça, era um cara incrível. Eu estou com a camisa que ele me deu. Meu filho era uma pessoa incrível e a morte dele foi brusca", afirmou.

"O meu filho não teve uma chance" afirmou mãe de Isaque, morto atropelado em Cabo Frio. — Foto: Inter TV

O advogado de defesa, Dr. Mauro Silva Sant’Anna , divulgou nota, informando que o motorista manifesta pesar pela morte de Isaque de Jesus Chermouth e pede desculpas à família da criança.

Segundo a defesa, Iano relata que, no momento em que saía com o veículo, teria ocorrido uma falha mecânica associada a um mal súbito, circunstâncias que teriam contribuído para o acidente. De acordo com o advogado, ele também pretende prestar apoio à família da vítima e colaborar com as investigações.

"Na qualidade de advogado do Sr. IANO ASSIS, venho, por meio desta nota, manifestar publicamente o profundo pesar de meu constituinte pelo trágico acidente ocorrido em Cabo Frio, que resultou no falecimento de uma criança de apenas 8 anos de idade e deixou também seu pai envolvido nessa dolorosa ocorrência.

Antes de qualquer esclarecimento, o Sr. Iano Assis deseja expressar suas mais sinceras desculpas à família, especialmente aos pais e familiares do menino, pela tragédia que se abateu sobre todos. Lamenta profundamente o ocorrido e reconhece que nenhuma palavra, gesto ou manifestação de solidariedade será capaz de diminuir a dor de uma família que perdeu um filho.

Segundo o relato de meu constituinte, no momento em que iniciava a saída com seu veículo, teria ocorrido uma falha mecânica, circunstância que, associada a um mal súbito que também teria apresentado naquele instante, contribuiu para o lamentável episódio. A criança encontrava-se à sua frente, sentada na bicicleta de seu pai.

O Sr. Iano encontra-se profundamente transtornado, emocionalmente abalado e inconformado com a tragédia. A situação tem provocado intenso sofrimento psicológico, motivo pelo qual está sob cuidados médicos e fazendo uso de medicação, com acompanhamento profissional, para conseguir manter seu estado emocional controlado.

É importante destacar que meu constituinte não é indiferente à dor da família. Ao contrário, encontra-se profundamente sensibilizado e deseja, dentro de suas possibilidades e com o devido respeito ao momento de luto, prestar todo o apoio e auxílio que estiverem ao seu alcance.

Tem plena consciência de que, por maior que seja sua solidariedade, por mais sinceras que sejam suas desculpas e por mais que deseje ajudar, nada poderá trazer de volta a vida do pequeno menino, cuja perda representa uma dor irreparável.

Por fim, o Sr. Iano Assis manifesta seu respeito à família enlutada, pede que suas desculpas sejam recebidas com a compreensão possível diante de tamanha tragédia e reafirma sua disposição de colaborar com os esclarecimentos necessários, respeitando integralmente a apuração dos fatos pelas autoridades competentes.

Neste momento, não existem palavras suficientes para expressar o tamanho da tristeza. Fica à família nossa mais sincera solidariedade, nosso respeito e nossas orações".

articles.title: VÍDEO: Guarda de honra desmaia diante de Macron na França | G1
articles.standfirst: Presidente francês e outras pessoas tentaram socorrer o homem, que foi carregado por agentes antes do início da cerimônia de recepção. Caso aconteceu nesta quarta-feira (11).
articles.summary: Presidente francês e outras pessoas tentaram socorrer o homem, que foi carregado por agentes antes do início da cerimônia de recepção. Caso aconteceu nesta quarta-feira (11).
articles.body:
Um integrante da Guarda de Honra da França desmaiou nesta quarta-feira (11) durante a chegada do presidente da Eslováquia, Peter Pellegrini, para uma visita oficial. Veja o momento no vídeo acima.

O caso aconteceu no Palácio Eliseu, que é a residência oficial do presidente da França em Paris.

O presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron , aguardava na escadaria do palácio, onde guardas estavam posicionados com espadas nas mãos para a cerimônia de recepção. Assim que o carro de Pellegrini chegou, um dos integrantes da guarda caiu.

Macron e outras pessoas que acompanhavam a cerimônia caminharam em direção ao homem para tentar socorrê-lo. Em seguida, agentes carregaram o guarda para retirá-lo do local.

Enquanto isso, Pellegrini permaneceu parado na base da escadaria. Depois que o homem foi retirado, Macron cumprimentou o presidente eslovaco.

Não há informações sobre o estado de saúde do guarda nem sobre o que provocou o desmaio, segundo a emissora eslovaca TV JOJ, que registrou a cena.

articles.title: Presidente da Câmara de Turvânia sofre lesão no olho após briga | G1
articles.standfirst: Álefe Matias foi atingido no olho esquerdo durante uma discussão com o controlador-geral do município. O servidor foi afastado temporariamente enquanto o caso é investigado pela administração municipal.
articles.summary: Álefe Matias, presidente da Câmara de Turvânia, passou por cirurgia após ser atingido no olho por um celular arremessado pelo controlador-geral do município.
articles.body:
Álefe Matias foi atingido por um aparelho celular durante briga na Câmara — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram e Arquivo pessoal

O vereador e presidente da Câmara de Turvânia , no oeste do estado, Álefe Matias Neves e Silva (MDB), de 31 anos, sofreu uma lesão em um dos olhos depois de ser atingido com um celular durante briga com o controlador-geral da Casa. Segundo o exame oftalmológico do parlamentar, a pancada quebrou os ossos que protegem a cavidade do olho, causando um rasgo nas partes internas do olho. O servidor envolvido no caso foi afastado por 30 dias.

Até a última atualização desta matéria, o g1 não conseguiu falar com o suspeito das agressões. A motivação da agressão também não foi mencionada.

Segundo a assessoria de Álefe Matias, a agressão aconteceu na tarde desta terça-feira (10). O presidente precisou de intervenção cirúrgica por causa dos ferimentos. No momento, ainda não é possível saber a extensão dos ferimentos, mas é certo que o vereador precisa retornar na próxima para retirar os curativos e realizar novos exames.

"Ele fez uma cirurgia ontem e possivelmente terá que fazer outras", disse a assessoria.

De acordo com a equipe do vereador, o controlador interno da Câmara arremessou um celular que acertou o olho esquerdo de Álefe, que precisou de uma cirurgia de emergência. A Câmara Municipal disse que instaurou um Processo Administrativo Disciplinar (PAD) e determinou a suspensão temporária por prazo estimado de 30 dias, para que os fatos sejam apurados.

O presidente da Câmara ressaltou que está totalmente focado em sua recuperação; ele agradeceu aos profissionais da clínica de olhos onde está sendo tratado na pessoa do doutor Thiago Silva. Álefe também disse que os demais fatos sobre o caso vão ser analisados e também agradeceu às milhares de mensagens de carinho enviadas.

articles.title: Operação Caronte: MPRJ busca prender Ricardo Magro e cúpula da Refit | G1
articles.standfirst: Operação Caronte investiga sonegação fiscal, organização criminosa e lavagem de dinheiro. Dívida tributária das empresas com o RJ supera R$ 15 bilhões.
articles.summary: A Operação Caronte cumpre mandados contra Ricardo Magro e ex-dirigentes da Refit por esquema de sonegação e lavagem de dinheiro que supera R$ 15 bilhões no Rio.
articles.body:
O Ministério Público do Rio de Janeiro (MPRJ) iniciou, nesta quarta-feira (11), a Operação Caronte , em que promotores tentam prender Ricardo Magro , controlador do falido Grupo Refit — da antiga Refinaria de Manguinhos — e considerado um dos maiores devedores de impostos do país , com um rombo de pelo menos R$ 50 bilhões .

Até a última atualização desta reportagem, 10 pessoas haviam sido presas no RJ e em SP — Magro não foi encontrado . O empresário está foragido desde maio , quando o Supremo Tribunal Federal ( STF ) decretou a prisão dele na 1ª fase da Operação Sem Refino , da Polícia Federal (PF), e acredita-se que esteja nos Estados Unidos .

O Grupo de Atuação Especializada de Defesa da Integridade e Repressão à Sonegação Fiscal (Gaesf/MPRJ) apura os crimes de sonegação fiscal , organização criminosa e lavagem de dinheiro . Os promotores afirmam que parentes de Magro faziam parte do esquema como laranjas e procuradores financeiros nas empresas da organização criminosa.

Entre os presos nesta quarta estão Ernesto dos Santos Andrade , tio do empresário ; Jorge Monteiro , ex-presidente da Refit ; e André Marques , piloto da Copa Truck . Outro procurado é Cristiano Beraldo , comentarista da Jovem Pan News e suplente de deputado federal pelo PP por SP.

A 2ª Vara Especializada da Comarca da Capital expediu 14 mandados de prisão, dos quais 5 seriam cumpridos no exterior, com auxílio de organismos internacionais — o MPRJ não esclareceu sobre esse trâmite.

Entre os alvos fora do Brasil estão os pais Ricardo Magro, Gabriela Andrade Magro e João Manuel Magro , residentes em Portugal.

Acreditava-se que Manuel Joaquim Andrade , um avô, também estava na Europa, mas ele foi encontrado em SP.

Como João e Manuel têm mais de 80 anos, a Justiça determinou prisão domiciliar.

O MPRJ não divulgou a lista completa dos alvos , mas afirmou que são 19 investigados.

A Justiça determinou o bloqueio de 170 imóveis, 371 veículos, 192 empresas, além de embarcações e aeronaves.

Manoel Joaquim Andrade, avô de Ricardo Magro (prisão domiciliar);

O advogado Antenor Mafra, de Jorge Monteiro, informou que não vai se pronunciar agora porque não teve acesso aos autos.

Os escritórios Juliana Bierrenbach Advogados e Fernando José da Costa Advogados, responsáveis pela defesa do empresário André Marques, manifestou surpresa. “A prisão preventiva constitui medida de natureza excepcional, cuja imposição exige a demonstração concreta e individualizada de sua necessidade, não podendo decorrer exclusivamente da gravidade dos fatos investigados ou de supostas vinculações empresariais. Não se evidencia a presença dos requisitos legais que justifiquem a adoção de medida tão excepcional quanto a prisão preventiva.”

A TV Globo tenta contato com a defesa dos demais.

André Marques , piloto da Fórmula Truck, é preso no Rio — Foto: Reprodução / TV Globo

Magro é apontado pelas autoridades como responsável pelo maior esquema de fraude tributária do país, com débitos estimados em R$ 50 bilhões .

A investigação do MPRJ apura crimes tributários que teriam sido praticados pela Refinaria de Manguinhos e pelas distribuidoras Flagler, Fera, Direcional, World Comércio, Phaenarete, Vaishia e 76 Oil, envolvendo a supressão e o não recolhimento de tributos que, em valores atualizados, teriam causado prejuízo superior a R$ 5,5 bilhões aos cofres públicos do RJ.

“A cadeia produtiva do setor, em síntese, funcionaria da seguinte forma: a refinaria importa derivados de petróleo ou os adquire de uma importadora, realiza o refino para a produção de gasolina e vende o combustível às distribuidoras, responsáveis pelo abastecimento dos postos”, disse o MPRJ.

“Segundo os promotores do Gaesf, as investigações criminais identificaram que o controlador da Refit também exercia o controle de todas as empresas envolvidas, desde a importadora até os postos de combustíveis”, prosseguiu.

“Essa estrutura teria permitido a prática sucessiva de fraudes fiscais, desde a aquisição da matéria-prima até a comercialização do produto ao consumidor final. Ainda segundo a investigação, o esquema deu origem a um jargão utilizado no setor: ‘Do porto ao posto sem pagar imposto’ .”

Ainda de acordo com os promotores, à medida que Magro se afastava formalmente dos quadros societários das empresas envolvidas, “ele era substituído por pessoas de sua confiança, incluindo familiares , que permanecem até hoje na estrutura empresarial como sócios formais ou procuradores habilitados”.

Essa estratégia teria permitido a manutenção do controle sobre as empresas e a continuidade das atividades ilícitas.

Segundo as investigações do Gaesf, a dívida tributária das empresas do grupo só com o RJ supera R$ 15 bilhões . Desse total, cerca de R$ 14 bilhões são atribuídos à Refinaria de Manguinhos.

Ricardo Magro — Foto: Fantástico/ TV Globo

Ricardo Magro já teve a prisão preventiva decretada pelo STF em maio deste ano, durante a Operação Sem Refino , da PF. A Corte também tinha determinado a inclusão do nome do empresário na Difusão Vermelha da Interpol, mecanismo de cooperação internacional usado para localizar e prender foragidos.

Na ocasião, Magro não foi encontrado. Segundo a investigação, ele mora há mais de 10 anos nos Estados Unidos e não retorna oficialmente ao Brasil desde 2018.

A PF apontou Magro como chefe de uma organização criminosa que teria usado empresas de fachada, fundos de investimento, holdings e offshores para sonegar impostos, lavar dinheiro e ocultar patrimônio no Brasil e no exterior.

De acordo com a investigação, recursos teriam sido enviados a empresas e fundos em locais como Delaware, nos Estados Unidos, Bahamas e Malta. Parte do dinheiro retornaria ao Brasil disfarçada de investimento ou seria usada na compra de imóveis e outros ativos.

Em 31 de agosto, a 5ª Vara Empresarial do Tribunal de Justiça do Rio de Janeiro converteu em falência a recuperação judicial das empresas do Grupo Refit , que se arrastava havia 11 anos. A decisão atingiu a Refinaria de Manguinhos.

No início do mesmo mês, a Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) já havia revogado a autorização de funcionamento da refinaria .

Antes disso, o governo do RJ cassou a inscrição estadual da Refit, impediu 19 empresas ligadas ao grupo de emitir notas fiscais de compra e venda de produtos e encerrou um benefício tributário relacionado às operações da companhia.

As investigações sobre o grupo também apuram o possível favorecimento da Refit por agentes públicos. Em agosto, a Operação Sem Refino 2 investigou suspeitas de irregularidades na concessão de licenças ambientais e contratos envolvendo a empresa e o RJ.

articles.title: $70,000 OPT fee could drive international students away from US, universities warn
articles.summary: A proposed US immigration rule imposing a $70,000 fee on universities for recommending international students for Optional Practical Training (OPT),
articles.body: A proposed US immigration rule imposing a $70,000 fee on universities for recommending international students for Optional Practical Training (OPT), followed by an additional $30,000 for subsequent recommendations, could drive away international students and undermine America's position as a leading global education destination, the Presidents' Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration has warned.In public comments submitted to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), the coalition, representing nearly 600 colleges and universities, has strongly opposed the proposed rule and urged the administration to withdraw it in its entirety.The proposed fees, published on Oct 8, 2026, would require educational institutions to pay $70,000 before recommending a student for initial OPT and $30,000 for each subsequent recommendation, including a STEM OPT extension. Universities could either absorb the substantial charges or seek to pass on the costs to students or employers, potentially making access to practical training dependent on students' financial means or an employer's willingness to pay.“If implemented, the proposed fees will put practical training out of reach for most students and campuses, effectively dismantling the OPT program as we know it, making it harder for employers to hire US-educated international graduates, and driving away new international students,” said Miriam Feldblum, president and CEO of the Presidents' Alliance.She warned that declining international enrolment would also hurt American students. “American students will suffer the consequences when international enrollment falls and colleges have a harder time sustaining courses and programs that support domestic students,” she said.The coalition cited a survey of 734 current and former international students, which found that 69% would probably or definitely not have enrolled in a US institution had the proposed fees been in place. Among STEM students, the figure was 70%.The economic implications could be considerable. International students contributed $42.9 billion to the US economy and supported over 3.5 lakh jobs during the 2024-25 academic year.Feldblum said the coalition shared the government's objective of preventing fraud and protecting American workers but questioned whether the proposed charges would achieve that purpose.“An institution’s ability to pay says nothing about whether a student qualifies or an employer follows the rules,” she said, warning that the proposal put America's position as a destination for global talent at risk.The submission also highlighted the financial burden on universities. One institution with approximately 6,000 international students estimated that the fees could cost it more than $60 million annually, exceeding 1% of its operating budget.The Alliance argued that restricting OPT could disrupt university research, employer partnerships and the pipeline of skilled graduates, while pushing talent towards competing destinations such as Canada, the UK, Australia and Germany.“When talented students from around the world choose to study and build their futures elsewhere, they take their skills, ideas, and innovations with them,” Feldblum said. “The next research discovery or successful startup won’t be in the US. That’s how we lose our competitive edge.”The coalition also questioned DHS's statutory authority to impose the charges, its justification for the amounts and the effectiveness of the proposal in preventing fraud.You use AI every day. articles.title: Former New York Jets coach Rex Ryan charged after allegedly running over feet of two pedestrians with truck
articles.summary: Former NFL head coach Rex Ryan, who led the New York Jets and Buffalo Bills, is accused of striking two pedestrians with his pickup truck last week in Nashville.
articles.body: Former NFL head coach Rex Ryan, who led the New York Jets and Buffalo Bills, is accused of striking two pedestrians with his pickup truck last week in Nashville. The incident happened shortly before midnight Thursday as Ryan was making a right turn onto Broadway, police said in a news release. Both pedestrians had minor injuries. According to the release, the two people were crossing with a walk signal when Ryan’s truck ran over their feet and struck one of them in the leg. The pair told police the truck kept going but stopped a short distance away at a red light. They said they flagged down the driver, and Ryan got out “to argue with them, got back in, and drove away,” the release states. They photographed the truck’s license plate and Ryan, who is currently an ESPN NFL analyst. When reached for comment ESPN said, “We are aware and are in touch with Rex.” Ryan, 63, was charged with two counts of leaving the scene of an accident, two counts of failure to give information/render aid, and two counts of failure to obey a traffic control signal. He surrendered for booking Wednesday morning, police said. His bond was set at $6,000.

articles.title: ‘Malign actors’: Ireland fears Russia could threaten undersea cables
articles.summary: Home to many US tech multinationals, Ireland raises alarm over Russia’s so-called shadow fleet.
articles.body:
Wexford, Ireland – They cross the ocean floor between continents, carrying nearly all our data, from messages and calls to trillions of dollars in financial transactions each day.

Subsea cables underpin global communications and power economies, but they are also increasingly seen as vulnerable to sabotage.

About 75 percent of transatlantic subsea cables pass through or near Irish waters, according to the Irish government, connecting North America with Europe – giving the small European Union member outsized strategic importance.

Ireland is also a major hub for United States tech multinationals, including Google, Microsoft and Meta, with a growing concentration of data centres supporting the digital economy.

But increased activity by Russian vessels near undersea infrastructure in recent years has raised concerns that cables around Ireland could become targets of interference.

In November 2024, the Russian ship Yantar, officially an oceanographic research vessel but described by the United Kingdom Ministry of Defence as a spy ship, was monitored near undersea infrastructure in the Irish Sea before being escorted out of Ireland’s exclusive economic zone by the Irish Navy.

Two months later, the UK’s Defence Ministry said the vessel had been “caught loitering over critical undersea infrastructure in UK waters.”

In late 2025, the British government accused Yantar of directing lasers at Royal Air Force (RAF) pilots monitoring its movements in the North Sea.

‘Ireland is absolutely Europe’s weakest link when it comes to defence’

Ireland has limited capability to monitor its waters – it has the lowest defence spending as a share of gross domestic product (GDP) in the EU, and its navy has no submarines. It is militarily neutral and not part of NATO.

Irish senator Tom Clonan, a strong supporter of Irish neutrality, argued that it should not be a barrier to boosting defence.

“Because of the end of the violence and the conflict in Ireland, and with the ceasefires and the peace agreement, we’ve had a peace dividend. So for the last 30 years, successive governments have really taken their foot off the accelerator when it comes to defence and security. And then, more broadly, Europe has enjoyed a peace dividend after the fall of the Berlin Wall,” he told Al Jazeera.

“So as a consequence of those two things, Ireland is absolutely Europe’s weakest link when it comes to defence in the air, maritime, ground and cyber domains,” he added.

The Irish government recently boosted its naval powers, allowing the navy to board and inspect suspicious vessels.

Ensuring defence against “emerging threats in our waters, particularly from vessels linked to the Russian shadow fleet ” is a priority, Defence Minister Helen McEntee said in March, referring to the ageing, often uninsured tankers used to transport Russian oil and circumvent Western sanctions.

Their presence in Irish waters has raised concerns about both accidental damage and deliberate interference with undersea infrastructure. Moscow disputes the term “shadow fleet” as a political fabrication.

“Recent events in the Baltic Sea and the activities of Russia’s shadow fleet have highlighted the importance of ensuring that we have the legal framework necessary to respond to evolving threats,” McEntee continued.

In December 2024, a tanker suspected of belonging to Russia’s shadow fleet was investigated after power and telecoms cables were damaged in the Gulf of Finland.

A year later, in December 2025 , a cargo ship sailing from St Petersburg under the flag of St Vincent and the Grenadines damaged telecommunications cables between Finland and Estonia. A Finnish court convicted its Russian captain and Azerbaijani boatswain of aggravated sabotage, according to the Reuters news agency. Both denied wrongdoing, and the conviction can be appealed.

For Daniel Mulhall, Ireland’s former ambassador to the US, that much of the world’s digital infrastructure passes through Irish waters means the country can no longer assume that its geographical position offers protection.

“It’s the fact that there are 850 US multinationals that have operations in Ireland. Many of them have big data centres to manage their data in our country,” he told Al Jazeera. “We are an integral part of the Western digital economy. And therefore, any sort of cyber threat to that economy is going to be potentially aimed at Ireland, or at least we could be victims of it, even if we’re not the prime target. So I think the world has become a far more complex place. And I think Irish people are waking up to that fact.”

Mulhall argued that protecting the cables will require international cooperation.

“I don’t think anyone can guarantee that those cables will be safe, least of all Ireland. But I think with collective effort, we can make reasonable preparations to strengthen our ability to protect those cables from malign actors that might wish to interfere with them,” he added.

“They’re the bloodstream of our economy. And if that bloodstream is interfered with, the economy will have serious trouble.”

Defence Minister Helen McEntee has raised concerns over Russia’s so-called shadow fleet [File: Omar Havana/Reuters]

articles.title: MICHAEL RUIZ: Texas police ID man charged with assault in UT Tyler Turning Point USA attack caught on video
articles.summary: Video captures a caped former student swinging a cane at Turning Point USA members before campus police arrest him at University of Texas Tyler.
articles.body: Texas authorities have identified a man accused of attacking students at a Turning Point USA tent on the University of Texas at Tyler campus Tuesday in the latest attack on the conservative youth organization whose founder was assassinated last year. Smith County booking records identify the suspect Ciro Tomlian. Video of the incident shows a man wearing a cape and a round-brimmed hat as he threw an American flag on the ground and swung a cane at a group of people. He is a former student who was not enrolled at the school at the time of the attack, according to authorities. Tomlian faces two charges of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon and another of assault causing bodily injury after allegedly striking TPUSA students with a cane. COLORADO TPUSA CHAPTER ENROLLMENT 'FLAT' AFTER ELDERLY SUPPORTER WAS STRICKEN BY STUDENT WITH TACO BELL CUP In the video, which shows the end of the encounter and Tomlian's arrest by campus police, the suspect grabs an American flag, throws it over his shoulder, gives the students the middle finger and can be heard saying "Back the f— off you fascist pieces of s—." A woman off-camera tells him to "stay away," and he raises the cane before taking a checked swing in her direction. The man identified as Tomlian screams "back up!" again, and the woman tells someone else to "just back up." Then a male voice, also off-camera, tells Tomlian, "No one's scared of you." That's when he swings the cane again, apparently striking the speaker, before someone else runs over and grabs the cane. Police arrive moments later and place the suspect in handcuffs. Once cuffed, he appears to paint the incident as self-defense and says, "freedom of speech does not mean freedom from consequences." VIDEO SHOWS POLLING PLACE ATTACK ON TURNING POINT MEMBER; POET ARRESTED "I apologize officer," he says as he's led away. "I was backed into a corner." In a statement, UT Tyler President Dr. Julie V. Philley confirmed that the attack took place at a Turning Point USA student event. SEND US A TIP "An individual, who is not a UT Tyler student, assaulted three people," she said. "UT Tyler police responded immediately and arrested the individual." He has been trespassed from school grounds. articles.title: Viral plane-etiquette debate erupts after man grabs passenger's aisle seat to sit with wife
articles.summary: A flight passenger aboard a Frontier Airlines plane gave up his assigned aisle seat after a man took it to sit next to his wife, igniting a fierce seat swap debate.
articles.body: A Frontier Airlines passenger gave up his assigned aisle seat after another traveler took it to sit next to his wife, creating a heated debate over airplane etiquette. The incident occurred Sunday, Nov. 8, on a flight from Atlanta to Jacksonville, Florida, as reported by travel blog "View from the Wing." The passenger arrived at his assigned seat, 28C, to find another man sitting there next to his wife. MAN TRIGGERS RELATIONSHIP CRISIS BY GRABBING FIRST CLASS, LEAVING WOMAN BEHIND IN COACH Instead of moving, the man reportedly offered the passenger his middle seat, 30E, two rows back. A flight attendant got involved but did not settle the dispute — leaving the passenger on his own to accept the middle seat, the blog said. "I just want to get home," the passenger reportedly said. The account was first shared by a witness on Reddit, though the post has since been deleted. MAJOR AIRLINE ROASTS PASSENGERS WHO JUMP UP RIGHT AFTER LANDING, IGNITING FIERCE BACKLASH Clint Henderson, New York-based managing editor at The Points Guy, told Fox News Digital his team frequently hears complaints about bad passenger behavior. The Points Guy recently commissioned a YouGov survey of more than 2,500 U.S. adults, which found that 42% believe airplane etiquette has worsened over the past five years. When it comes to seat swapping, 44% of respondents said it is not rude to ask another passenger to switch seats, while 34% said it is rude, according to the survey. Henderson said asking is acceptable, but passengers should not expect someone to give up a better seat. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE STORIES "If it's an even exchange, or you want to sit with your family, I think then you have every right to ask," he said. "But you also have to know ‘no’ is a full answer, and people are allowed to refuse you." The Frontier incident led to a similar debate online. "Trading for [a] middle seat is outrageous. Gotta upgrade if you wanna swap," one Reddit user wrote. Others questioned why the passenger did not insist on keeping his assigned seat, while some said they understood why a tired traveler might decide an argument was just not worth it. CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER "There's definitely been at least one late night flight after work where I'm just way too tired to have the energy to argue," another commenter wrote. Henderson said seat-swapping disputes have become more complicated as travelers increasingly pay extra to get specific seats. "It's become much more fraught because a lot of passengers have paid good money for better seats in the economy cabin," he said. If a disagreement does arise on board, Henderson advised passengers not to escalate it themselves. TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ "Don't try to fight with passengers yourself," he said. "Don't get involved in the drama." Instead, he recommended calling a flight attendant and allowing the crew to handle the situation. The survey also found that 52% of Americans blame fellow passengers for poor behavior aboard planes, rather than airline companies or social media. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "I would have thought that Americans were angry at the big airline companies, but they're actually mad at their fellow passengers, and they just want common courtesy," Henderson said. articles.title: ‘SOS’ call from Ladakh leaders & Wangchuk, to President, PM and HM for poll deferment
articles.summary: SRINAGAR: As Ladakh’s administration Wednesday imposed a complete ban on protests and demonstrations within the municipal limits of Leh and Kargil, citing
articles.body: SRINAGAR: As Ladakh’s administration Wednesday imposed a complete ban on protests and demonstrations within the municipal limits of Leh and Kargil, citing the municipal and hill council polls scheduled for Nov 23 and Dec 4, respectively, Ladakhi leaders, including Leh Apex Body (LAB) member and climate activist Sonam Wangchuk, appealed to President Droupadi Murmu, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union home minister Amit Shah to intervene to defer the polls, citing harsh winter conditions and the likely exclusion of a large section of the electorate.“It is an SOS call from Ladakh to the President, the Prime Minister and the Union home minister. We are sending this message to the people of India also,” the joint appeal said.Earlier in the day, the office of the chief electoral officer issued an order stating that the model code of conduct has been enforced and will remain in force till the completion of the election process. The order said organising of political dharnas, protests, demonstrations, sit-ins, rallies or similar collective activities within the municipal limits of Leh and Kargil during the currency of the model code of conduct has the potential to intimidate voters, disturb public order, and vitiate the atmosphere for free and fair elections.Flanked by Ladakh MP Mohmad Haneefa, LAB co-chairman Chering Dorjay Lakrook and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) co-chairmen Asgar Ali Karbali and Sajjad Kargili, Wangchuk said the administration was forcing elections on people during the harsh winter, when temperatures in some parts of Ladakh fall below minus 30°C. “Ladakh is known as the world’s coldest inhabited place. The weather forecast for Dec indicates snowfall. How will elections be conducted in such conditions? Half of the population is outside Ladakh, while students are already studying in different cities. When Leh, Kargil and other areas are nearly empty, why are you holding elections?” he asked.“Indian democracy has a great tradition in Ladakh. Earlier, even two voters in Demchok were facilitated through helicopters to ensure their participation. So why is the administration ignoring half of the population now,” Wangchuk said. He appealed to the country’s leadership, including the opposition and people across India, to pay attention to Ladakh and oppose what he termed an arbitrary decision by the lieutenant-governor’s administration. Haneefa said he had met the Ladakh L-G and told him holding elections during winter would deprive a large number of people of their right to vote. He said despite it they issued the poll notification.Lakrook said holding elections during peak winter was unheard of in Ladakh. He said May or June would be more suitable time ensure maximum voter participation. Karbali accused the L-G of imposing its decisions on Ladakh’s people. He said the region has traditionally recorded around 90% voter turnout but the administration was scheduling elections at a time when nearly 30% of the population would be outside the Union Territory.Kargili alleged that the administration was making every effort to defame LAB and KDA and that holding elections in Dec was an infringement of people’s voting rights and a denial of adequate political representation.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Zohran Mamdani’s influence grows as Democrats eye 2028 strategies
articles.summary: Progressive strategists explain how Mamdani’s 2025 mayoral campaign offered a ‘real model’ for other progressives.
articles.body:
Democrats have notched their strongest showing in decades in the 2026 midterm elections, taking control of both chambers of the United States Congress, as well as a share of the country’s gubernatorial races.

In the aftermath, television networks scrambled to book the night’s biggest winners and most recognisable faces to comment on the results.

But one of the most sought-after figures was not a longtime Democratic leader like Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer or House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries. It was Zohran Mamdani, the mayor of New York City – and a figurehead for a burgeoning progressive movement.

At New York Governor Kathy Hochul’s re-election watch party in Midtown Manhattan, a newly shaven, moustache-wearing Mamdani took the stage to celebrate what he described as a victory for the broader left-wing political movement.

“We have begun the work of transforming our party and making it belong to working people once again,” Mamdani told a roaring crowd.

In the days that followed, Mamdani appeared on networks ranging from left-leaning MS NOW to the more conservative Fox News to discuss the growing clout of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA), the organisation with which he is affiliated.

Several DSA-backed candidates succeeded in the November 3 midterms, including the Mamdani-endorsed politician Claire Valdez, who won New York’s seventh congressional district.

Democratic socialists also triumphed in mayoral elections from Washington, DC, to Providence, Rhode Island, and Los Angeles , California. Elsewhere, progressives captured key races around the country, including toss-up Senate contests in Maine and Michigan.

Supporters of the progressive movement see this year’s midterms as a turning point for Democratic politics overall. They credit Mamdani with setting the landslide in motion.

“On the candidate and campaign side, we now have a path – cleared by Zohran and now being paved by others – for this kind of authentic, populist and competent progressive leadership,” Adin Lenchner, founder of New York-based political consultancy Carroll Street Campaigns, told Al Jazeera.

Lenchner called figures like Mamdani “a real model nationally” for the left wing.

New York City’s mayors have long occupied a prominent place in US politics, commanding a national profile well beyond the city’s limits.

Rudy Giuliani, for example, was dubbed “America’s mayor” after the attacks on September 11, 2001. Bill de Blasio became a fixture on national television during the COVID-19 pandemic. But Mamdani’s ascent has been different.

At the start of 2025, Mamdani was a relatively unknown state assemblyman from Queens. His mayoral bid was widely regarded as a long shot. But his grassroots organising, social media operation and economic message quickly turned his campaign into a national phenomenon.

That message – focused largely on affordability – resonated with political strategist Nomiki Konst, who worked on the 2016 presidential campaign for US Senator Bernie Sanders, another democratic socialist.

She remembers connecting with the Sanders campaign in a way she had not with mainstream Democrats.

“I couldn’t necessarily articulate my frustration with the Democratic Party and what they were not providing for me,” Konst said.

“But then suddenly Bernie Sanders started talking about student loan debt, and I was like, ‘Oh, that’s the thing that’s killing me right now. That is why I feel like I can’t get by, like I’m just constantly on a hamster wheel.'”

Konst is currently organising for other progressive candidates to compete in the 2028 elections, building on this year’s midterm momentum.

She anticipates campaigns like Mamdani’s – that focus on the “crushing weight of this monopoly-driven crony capitalism” – will continue to be relevant in 2028, just as they were this year.

For Lenchner, the success of progressive and democratic socialist candidates in the 2026 midterms hinged on affordability issues. Voters consistently ranked the cost of living among their top concerns in pre-election polls.

He pointed to the parallel with Mamdani’s 2025 campaign, which included videos explaining how street food had become so expensive.

“Understanding that the same forces that make halal trucks expensive and limit immigrants from being able to run food carts are the same forces that are keeping people off healthcare and keeping their rent high,” Lenchner said.

“I think that is the connective tissue that Zohran has so expertly told the story of and connected for voters.”

Political insiders say Mamdani’s victory in 2025 also offered a lesson for midterm candidates today: that the political establishment is not invincible, and candidates willing to challenge it can win.

In 2025, Mamdani’s main opponent was former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo, a candidate who had name recognition, political connections and institutional backing.

Despite resigning his governorship in 2021 over sexual misconduct allegations, Cuomo was long thought to be the frontrunner.

Instead, he lost the Democratic primary to Mamdani, 56 percent to 44. He ran in the general election as an independent, only to lose again, with Mamdani taking just over 50 percent of the vote to Cuomo’s nearly 42 percent.

Progressive operatives see that willingness to stare down long odds as one of the biggest takeaways from Mamdani’s dark-horse campaign.

Early in his campaign, the future mayor was polling at barely 1 percent in pre-election polls, with Cuomo by far the frontrunner. At the time, his identity as a democratic socialist was seen as a weakness.

To Konst, the lesson is that political affiliation matters less than overarching questions of economic inequality.

“The people who are holding up this country are the corporate class, which likes to divide us based on its designation of what left and right is,” Konst said.

“It’s up versus down. There’s no left or right in this country, and people are changing their minds every day.”

Mamdani’s campaign also demonstrated the appeal of small-dollar fundraising, with the vast majority of its contributions coming in amounts under $250.

In 2026, DSA candidates in New York also banked on a lot of small donors.

Political insiders trace Mamdani’s strategy of redirecting attention to the economy to some of this year’s most surprising victories.

In Texas, James Talarico defeated Republican Ken Paxton in the Senate race, becoming the first Democrat to win statewide office in the state in more than 30 years.

In Michigan, another Senate candidate, Abdul El-Sayed , faced repeated questions about his position on Israel and Gaza, but instead centred his campaign on a pledge to redirect money for the war towards domestic priorities.

Konst, the political strategist, said she has already started to look at how to leverage last week’s midterm success into future races.

“I think, on the left, we need to take the momentum out of our wins on Tuesday and channel it into something,” Konst said.

In her case, that has meant scoping out potential 2028 presidential candidates. She is co-chairing a draft committee urging US Representative Ro Khanna of California, an outspoken progressive, to run.

Whether Mamdani’s influence can translate into a lasting national movement remains to be seen.

Critics warn that the 2026 midterm victories may reflect more the backlash to US President Donald Trump than support for a progressive political surge.

But Konst hopes that, on election night in 2028, she might find herself experiencing the same anticipation and enthusiasm she felt during the midterms.

Only this time, her eyes are not on the halls of Congress or city hall, but the White House.

articles.title: Famed ship SS United States to be sunk off coast of Florida
articles.summary: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
articles.body:
A ship that was once the fastest in the world and is longer than the Titanic will be sunk off the coast of Florida and turned into the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

The SS United States spent nearly 30 years docked in Philadelphia before it was moved to Florida, where it will soon become a home for sealife and an underwater attraction for marine enthusiasts.

Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner - which crossed the Atlantic Ocean hundreds of times - to be preserved as a museum.

Instead, after being purchased by a Florida county, it will be added to the dozens of artificial reefs off the coast, as a land-based museum detailing the ship's history is also planned.

Before its retirement, the SS United States was known for carrying royalty and celebrities from the US the Europe, beginning in 1952 and ending in 1969.

A young Bill Clinton, before he was president, used the ship to cross the Atlantic. Former presidents Harry Truman, Dwight Eisenhower and John Kennedy also travelled on the vessel.

The ship was moved from Philadelphia to Alabama last year for cleaning and remediation work. On Monday, it took its final journey from Alabama to the coast of Destin, Florida, where it will be sunk on Wednesday in a precision operation without explosives.

Stars including Marlon Brando, Coco Chanel, Duke Ellington, Salvador Dali, Walt Disney, Judy Garland and Cary Grant also boarded the ship during its sailing lifetime.

Before its purchase by the municipal Florida government, a number of proposals that would have seen the ship live a second life as a museum or a floating hotel failed.

Instead, the famed ship sat at various docks with various owners as legal battles played out.

The SS United States Conservancy group repeatedly attempted to keep the ship above water, but was unsuccessful.

Conservancy President Susan Gibbs - whose grandfather helped design the SS United States - said she was glad that the story of the ship would live on.

"[The ship] has always been this unabashedly American symbol that brings so many people together," Gibbs told CBS News, the BBC's US partner.

articles.title: More than one million people in Lebanon face acute food shortages, UN says
articles.summary: UN warns hunger crisis affecting almost quarter of Lebanon’s population could escalate without ‘urgent action’.
articles.body:
Nearly a quarter of Lebanon’s population, or more than one million people, is facing acute food shortages due to two consecutive conflicts in less than two years and a dire economic situation, according to the United Nations.

The UN’s Food and Agriculture Organization, the World Food Programme (WFP) and Lebanon’s Ministry of Agriculture warned in a joint statement published on Wednesday that the number is expected to rise to 1.15 million by the middle of next year.

“Employment opportunities remain limited, savings have been depleted, and debt remains high, while the cost of food, fuel and other essentials continues to strain household budgets,” the joint statement said.

“Some households can still draw on savings, borrow, cut expenses or find other ways to put food on the table. For others, those options are being exhausted. When families have nothing left to fall back on, even a small additional shock can push them deeper into crisis,” Allison Oman Lawi, WFP representative and country director in Lebanon, said.

Lebanon’s Agriculture Minister Nizar Hani said: “These findings call for a coordinated national response that addresses urgent food needs while protecting livelihoods and restoring productive capacity.”

Lebanon’s authorities estimate that the cost of two wars between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since October 2023 amounts to about $27bn.

The last war, launched in March, displaced more than one million people in Lebanon. That number has fallen to about 300,000 since violence subsided in June.

Despite a United States-brokered framework deal signed between Israel and Lebanon’s government in June to bring fighting to an end, Israel is still occupying land in Lebanon.

Under the terms, Israeli forces were to withdraw, and Lebanon’s army was to take up positions in vacated territory.

Lebanon was meant to disarm Hezbollah, which is not a party to the agreement.

The fighting broke out as Lebanon struggled to recover from its worst-ever economic crisis, which began in 2019.

Beirut has been seeking a bailout from the International Monetary Fund but has yet to implement reforms demanded by the institution to release the aid.

articles.title: Teen charged with murder in fatal shooting of 15-year-old NYC student Javits Frimpong
articles.summary: A 17-year-old faces a murder charge in the New York City shooting of Javits Frimpong, a 15-year-old Ghanaian immigrant killed walking to school.
articles.body: A 17-year-old boy has been arrested after a teenager was fatally shot while walking to school in New York City last month, police announced Wednesday. The teen suspect, who has not been publicly identified, faces a murder charge in the Oct. 29 death of 15-year-old Javits Frimpong, according to the New York City Police Department (NYPD). "The NYPD will be relentless in our efforts to get dangerous people out of our communities, especially when it involves the murder of a 15-year-old boy," the department wrote in a post on X. Javits, a Ghanaian immigrant, was fatally shot in the stomach in the Bronx. His father believes the killing may be linked to ongoing bullying his son experienced at school. Just two days before the tragedy, the school’s principal had called Thomas Frimpong to report that his son was being targeted and that two students had been suspended as a result. The tragic killing sparked local protests and urgent calls from community members to end youth violence and bullying. Last week, NYPD Chief of Detectives Joseph Kenny noted that investigators were exploring multiple angles. "The alleged bullying is one aspect that we’re looking at, as well as some others," Kenny told the New York Post. "All three gave chase," Kenny added. "And these cowards shot him in the back. If their intention was to rob him, he dropped his backpack." PARENTS IN BRONX NEIGHBORHOOD PLEAD FOR NYPD GUARD AS MAMDANI CUTS COPS, HALTS HIRES: 'HORRIBLE SITUATION' "As of right now, all indications are that he was trying to live the American dream," the chief said. "He was trying to get ahead by going to school. We have nothing in our investigation to indicate he was involved in any gang activity. Seems like he was just a very good kid." The tragedy also prompted federal intervention to support the grieving family. President Donald Trump agreed to grant Javits’ mother an emergency visa so she could travel to the United States from Ghana to lay her son to rest.
